title: Newmark Continues its Growth in France with the Launch of Two New Business Divisions: Logistics and Debt
summary: Newmark announces the company has entered a new strategic phase of its gorwh in France with the launch of two new business divisions, Industrial & Logistics and Debt & Structured Finance.
body_markdown: Newmark announces the company has entered a new strategic phase of its gorwh in France with the launch of two new business divisions, Industrial & Logistics and Debt & Structured Finance.
